title: AI is blowing up music. How should the Grammys handle it?
brief: Harvey Mason Jr., CEO of the Recording Academy, discusses how AI has become "omnipresent" in music production, with over 50,000 AI-generated songs uploaded daily to streaming platforms like Deezer, while the Grammys maintain a rule excluding AI-generated music from eligibility. The conversation explores how major institutions are grappling with AI integration in creative fields and the challenges of identifying and filtering AI-created content.
